model.UNSTATED PREMISE THE PREDICTION NEEDS (f: the aim compensation turns about the OLD LOCAL frame y-axis (East) while the draw pitch turns about the EYE x-axis s. With viewing_mode=equator, s = earthEquToLocal((equ_vision[1], -equ_vision[0], 0)); s is parallel to local East if and only if the view direction is PERPENDICULAR to local East, i.e. the view lies in the MERIDIAN plane. The 'exact cancellation at fov 180' claim, and the o*(90-fov/2) formula, therefore hold only for a meridian view. THE RUN IS DESIGNED TO SATISFY IT (target body placed on the meridian by a measured JD search) and the dependence is itself a finding.

Scene stated instead: shipped default config (Marseille +43d18'/+05d22', alt 75 m, home Earth, viewing_mode equator, heading 0), atmosphere/landscape/stars off, time FROZEN, target = the Sun at MERIDIAN TRANSIT (measured JD, not recalled), farm config's init_view_pos set to the measured local-frame direction of the target so that the ONE sink's re-aim target IS the body.
